params.verdict: pass — by the bar the owner set
params.rule_applied: Total return over 2025-01-01..2026-11-13 of at least +10%. The registered configuration (20 days, 20%, band 0.10, cap 0.98) returned +60.3%. The window was read once, by one command.
params.what_the_pass_does_and_does_not_show: The registration said in advance that a long-only rule clears an absolute bar whenever the fund rose enough, and that the same bar would be put to holding the fund and to a fixed position. Both clear it by more: holding returned +109.7% and the fixed 77% position +83.1%. So the pass shows that being long SOXX through this window was enough. It does not show that the sizing earned the return; the sizing gave return away.
params.what_the_sizing_did_in_the_test_window: It traded return for drawdown. The rule kept 55% of the fund's return (+60.3% of +109.7%) and took 55% of its worst drawdown (-21.9% against -39.5%). Sharpe was 1.20 against 1.10 for the fund and for any fixed fraction of it. Against the fixed position chosen before the window opened (77%, the rule's design-window average) it returned 23 points less and drew down 9.5 points less; it held 57% on average here, not 77%, because the window was more volatile than the design years.

in_the_two_falls.2025_spring: SOXX fell 34.2% from 2025-01-22 to 2025-04-08. The rule fell 21.9% over the same days and was holding 42% at the low.
in_the_two_falls.2026_second_half: SOXX peaked on 2026-06-22 and was 39.5% lower at its low on 2026-11-05. The rule was holding 36% on the day of the peak, because volatility had already risen on the way up, and lost 15.5% to that low. As of 2026-11-13 the fund is 31.6% below its peak and the rule 13.0% below its own.
in_the_two_falls.now: 20-day realised volatility 79% annualised; target weight 25%, held 32% (inside the 10-point band).

params.design_window_said_this_first: On 2007-2024 the rule's timing alpha was -1.9% a year, inside what skill-free histories produce (sign-flip p = 0.751, shuffle p = 0.920), and its Sharpe gap to the fund was +0.01 (sign-flip p = 0.682). Total return +567% against +726% for a fixed 77% and +1,181% for the fund; worst drawdown -48.0% against -56.5% and -66.8%. No evidence over eighteen years that scaling by volatility improved return per unit of risk on this fund; clear evidence that it cut the depth of the falls. The test window repeated that pattern rather than adding to it.
params.the_two_halves_of_the_design_window_disa: 2007-2018: Sharpe 0.44 against 0.46, behind the fixed position. 2019-2024: Sharpe 0.97 against 0.87, ahead. The test window's 1.20 against 1.10 sits with the second half. Three readings, two for and one against, none individually distinguishable from nothing.
params.neighbouring_settings: All eight (20 or 60 days; 15, 20, 25, 30%) clear the bar, from +43.1% to +78.3%, with drawdowns from -16.0% to -31.1% in step with the risk level. The verdict does not hinge on the setting, and the setting is a risk dial rather than a source of edge. None of them is promoted to the strategy.
params.engine_check: The registered configuration run through the real backtest engine on SOXX 2007-01-01..2026-11-13 ends at 1,068,653.41 USD, as does the simulator; 278 fills in both, no rejected orders, largest daily difference 0.0000 USD.
limits: One instrument, one window of 1.9 years, in which the fund doubled. This is one observation of a rule doing what it is built to do in a market that happened to end up.

The bar could not have failed a long SOXX position of almost any size in this window. A window in which the fund ended lower would have tested the rule; this one tested whether it stayed invested enough.
Cash earned nothing in the simulation; at the short rates of the window the rule's 43% average cash share would have added roughly two points a year. This understates the rule.
The comparison with the fixed position is at unequal exposure (57% held against 77%). Sharpe is the exposure-neutral reading.
params.status: Candidate for paper trading under the existing promotion path. Not promoted by this record.
params.test_window_is_now_spent: 2025-01-01..2026-11-13 has been read for this rule, the fund, a fixed position and eight neighbouring settings. Any later rule scored on these dates is being scored on a window whose shape is known, and should say so.
